title: Shortest superpermutation on 7 symbols
statement: Find a string over 1..7 that contains every permutation of 1..7 as 7 consecutive characters, as short as possible. The shortest known, by Teodorescu (2026), has length 5905; a shorter one improves it.
submission: Text file: the string, digits 1..7 (whitespace ignored).
score: the length of the string (smaller is better)

best_known.source: L(7) <= 5905: Teodorescu (2026), in Leaps in Bounds (github.com/daniel-munro/leaps-in-bounds), data at commit 4521e13 (8 Nov 2026); read 8 Nov 2026
